attempts.summary: Created the appworker account on node1 and configured /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf to cap its login sessions at 8192 open files (nofile) and 256 processes (nproc), enforced via pam_limits. Verified pre- and post-reboot that the account exists and the limits are applied in a real login session, and confirmed node1's boot_id changed across a single safe reboot, proving persistence.
